M. Enayetur Rahim J. The respective parties have filed an application for recording compromise between them and to dispose of the instant civil petition for leave to appeal in terms of Solenama (Compromise agreement dated 25.10.2023). 

 7. However, in the meantime the principal parties of the Writ Petition with a view to resolve the dispute and to avoid any further ill feelings the writ-petitioner No.2 and writ-respondent No.4 leave petitioner mutually agreed to settle the dispute out of the Court and accordingly both the parties have executed a Solenama (Compromise agreement on 25.10.2023) keeping the concerned Ministry as party on the terms and condition as mentioned therein, which are as follows: 

 8. In the compromise application the respective parties have asserted that the aforesaid Solenama (Compromise agreement dated 25.10.2023, Annexure-Z) is valid and legal and not opposed to any law and is for the betterment of all the parties herein and on the basis of the said com-promise the instant Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.619 of 2023 may kindly be disposed of.
